goal: Design a LangGraph parity prototype that mirrors NativeAgentRuntimeV2 capabilities without editing source files, activating LangGraph as default, or weakening governance.
summary: Created a complete blueprint for a future flag-gated LangGraph parity runtime. The blueprint maps every Native V2 capability to a LangGraph node/component, preserves governance/tool/memory/trace/checkpoint contracts, and defines a phased implementation path with tests. No source code was modified in this front.
design_decisions: Native V2 stays canonical; LangGraph parity is an optional future backend.
All governance and tool execution remain mediated by existing native modules.
capability_metadata is derived using the same helper as native to avoid client drift.
Native persistence (run.json, checkpoint.json, trace.jsonl) remains the source of truth.
Implementation is split into 7 phases; only Phase 7 touches runtime.py and only for a flag-gated selector.
next_recommended_actions: Review and approve the blueprint artifacts.
Decide on checkpointer strategy (MemorySaver vs SqliteSaver).
Begin Phase 0 in a new front: create tmp_agent/brain_v9/core/agent_kernel_v2/langgraph_parity_runtime.py skeleton.
Do not modify runtime.py or activate LangGraph as default until the parity smoke test passes.
